practice.name: Bayside Animal Medical Center
practice.tagline: Full-service veterinary care in Severna Park since 1996.
practice.description: Bayside Animal Medical Center is a full-service veterinary hospital in Severna Park, Maryland, providing preventive medicine, diagnostics, surgery, dentistry, acupuncture, exotic pet care, grooming, pharmacy, and compassionate care for pets and their families.
practice.serviceArea: Severna Park, Arnold, Millersville, Annapolis, Pasadena, and Glen Burnie, MD

team.name: Lawrence F. Steinberg, DVM
team.bio: Dr. Steinberg opened Bayside Animal Medical Center in February 1996 after earning his DVM from the University of Georgia.

team.name: Alexandra F. Bray, VMD, CVA
team.bio: Dr. Bray joined Bayside in 2008 and provides acupuncture and Chinese herbal medicine in addition to traditional veterinary care.

team.name: Sondra Oliver, DVM
team.bio: Dr. Oliver graduated from the Virginia-Maryland Regional School of Veterinary Medicine in 1999.

team.name: Kathryn Buchanan, VMD
team.bio: Dr. Buchanan has a special interest in exotic animals and earned her VMD from the University of Pennsylvania in 2012.

team.name: Allyson DeLozier, VMD
team.bio: Dr. DeLozier has interests in exotic animal medicine, soft tissue surgery, and some orthopedic surgery.

team.name: Brittney Beigel, DVM
team.bio: Dr. Beigel joined Bayside in 2020 and is a Severna Park native.

team.name: Rebekah Sims, DVM
team.bio: Dr. Sims focuses on preventive and integrative care, including acupuncture and hospice care training.

team.name: Julia Langfitt, DVM
team.bio: Dr. Langfitt has practiced small animal medicine internationally and returned to Maryland in 2023.
